title: Responsive Workspace and Edit Holes Redesign
notes: Uses a compact, height-aware workspace toolbar to return more screen space to the canvas.
Changes Edit Drill Holes and Edit Holes into adaptive drawers with Select, Move, Transform, and More tool groups.
Integrates pattern assignment directly into the edit workflow instead of stacking a second dialog over the edit panel.
Keeps modal titles and primary actions reachable while long forms scroll.
Preserves role-based access, cloud rules compatibility, permanent document identity, header preservation, rotation, and conflict safeguards.
